stories.title: How Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil stands out from all other game adaptations
stories.summary: Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil adaptation omits familiar characters such as Leon, Claire and Ada Wong. Instead, the film aims to recreate the strange and frightening experience of playing the game itself.

links.headline: How Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil stands out from all other game adaptations
links.excerpt: There’s no Leon, Claire or Ada Wong in Cregger’s adaptation.
